anyOf.description: Name of the icon asset icons/<name>.png that destinations publish. Create it with stemma icon or commit a square PNG.

icon.description: Name of the icon asset icons/<name>.png that destinations publish. Create it with stemma icon or commit a square PNG.

signature.description: Require a complete Authenticode signature from the configured publisher on the setup file.

signer.description: Expected publisher identity: apple:developer-id:<TEAMID> or authenticode:<SHA256>. Use stemma signature to inspect the input and derive it.

source.description: Vendor installer or a resource output. A WindowsSoftware document requires a source.

suspend.description: Keep the resource out of every run that does not select it. It still validates and keeps its reviewed lock entries; selecting it, or a suspended resource consuming its outputs, runs it.

description: A Project imports family files containing resource documents separated by ---. Each kind owns preparation; destination operations own native publication fields.
title: Stemma documents
